events.title: Legal & General Group Plc Acquires Shares of 1,133,223 Equinix, Inc. $EQIX
events.summary: Legal & General Group Plc has acquired a significant new position in Equinix, Inc., purchasing over 1.1 million shares valued at approximately $1.18 billion in the second quarter. Other institutional investors like BlackRock Inc. and Cohen & Steers Inc. also hold substantial stakes, with Equinix showing strong financial performance, including beating earnings estimates and announcing a quarterly dividend.

events.title: Resilient Expeditors stock trades near 52-week high as Q2 2026 earnings beat expectations
events.summary: Expeditors International (EXPD) stock is trading near its 52-week high at $187.81 after reporting better-than-expected Q2 2026 earnings of $2.03 per share, driven by strong airfreight and customs brokerage operations. Despite a consensus analyst "Hold" rating and an average price target of $168.78 suggesting limited upside, the company's strong profitability, efficient use of capital, and recent institutional interest support its current valuation. The contrast between the market price and analyst targets highlights investor confidence in Expeditors' ability to maintain strong margins and returns on equity.

articles.headline: Resilient Expeditors stock trades near 52-week high as Q2 2026 earnings beat expectations

events.title: Occidental Petroleum stock holds a strong 2026 gain as analysts stay cautious
events.summary: Occidental Petroleum (OXY) stock has seen a strong 46% year-to-date gain in 2026, trading in the low-$60s range, partially fueled by a significant Q2 2026 earnings beat. Despite this robust performance, analyst sentiment remains cautious, with a consensus Hold rating and price targets clustered in the mid-$60s, suggesting limited upside without new catalysts. The company's performance has outpaced some peers, reflecting strong operational execution and leverage to commodity prices, but much of this is already factored into the current valuation.

articles.headline: Occidental Petroleum stock holds a strong 2026 gain as analysts stay cautious

events.title: Dollar General stock edges higher as earnings beat odds become focus
events.summary: Dollar General (DG) stock is trading in the mid-$120s as investors await its upcoming quarterly earnings report. Analysts expect a 7.5% year-over-year increase in earnings to $2.00 per share, with a consensus "hold" rating and a one-year price target of $130.42. The company's focus on consumables and its defensive retail model are key factors in its anticipated steady performance amidst macroeconomic uncertainties.

articles.headline: Dollar General stock edges higher as earnings beat odds become focus

events.title: Which Aerospace and Defense Stock Has Dominated in 2026: GE Aerospace, Boeing, or RTX?
events.summary: In 2026, RTX has emerged as the top performer among major aerospace and defense stocks, with a 14% year-to-date gain, followed by GE Aerospace at 11%. Boeing, however, has lagged significantly with a 3% decline. The article highlights that these companies, despite being in the same sector, have fundamentally different business models—GE Aerospace focuses on recurring engine servicing, RTX on a diversified portfolio, and Boeing on airframe manufacturing, explaining their varied performances.

articles.headline: Which Aerospace and Defense Stock Has Dominated in 2026: GE Aerospace, Boeing, or RTX?

events.title: Clean energy groups call on regulators to reject We Energies rate hike
events.summary: Clean energy and environmental groups in Wisconsin are urging state regulators to reject We Energies' proposed 14% residential electric rate hike, citing the significant burden on low-income residents and concerns over rising costs. We Energies argues the increases are necessary to fund $600 million in new clean energy projects and replace older facilities, while also clarifying that costs for artificial intelligence data centers will not impact residential bills. Advocacy groups contend the utility has repeatedly broken promises regarding coal plant closures and clean energy commitments, despite achieving record profits.

articles.headline: Clean energy groups call on regulators to reject We Energies rate hike

events.title: Which Oil and Gas Stock Has Dominated in 2026: ConocoPhillips, EOG Resources, or Occidental Petroleum?
events.summary: In 2026, Occidental Petroleum (OXY) leads the oil and gas sector with a 46% year-to-date gain, closely followed by EOG Resources (EOG) and ConocoPhillips (COP) which both achieved a 43% gain. The SPDR S&P Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (XOP) outperformed two of these individual stocks with a 45% return, suggesting that for most investors, a sector-wide ETF might have been a more effective choice than picking individual stocks this year. The article highlights the narrow margin between the top performers and the ETF, advising investors to maintain modest single-stock positions.

articles.headline: Which Oil and Gas Stock Has Dominated in 2026: ConocoPhillips, EOG Resources, or Occidental Petroleum?

events.title: SunCar Technology Group Inc. Class A Trade Ideas — NASDAQ:SDA
events.summary: SunCar Technology Group (NASDAQ: SDA) operates a cloud service and mobile app that digitalizes the automotive aftermarket and e-insurance sectors in China, partnering with major EV manufacturers. The company experienced significant revenue growth in FY 2023, particularly in its auto e-insurance business, and has recently shown positive Adjusted EBITDA. SunCar addresses the need for aftermarket support in China's rapidly growing EV market, which lacks extensive dealer networks, and aims to make car ownership more efficient and affordable through its platform.

articles.headline: SunCar Technology Group Inc. Class A Trade Ideas — NASDAQ:SDA

events.title: Martin Marietta Finalizes $13.5 Billion Acquisition of Lhoist North America
events.summary: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. (NYSE: MLM) has finalized its acquisition of Lhoist North America, Inc. for approximately $13.5 billion, comprising $7 billion in cash and 10,953,543 shares of common stock. The deal, completed on August 21, 2026, also includes governance changes such as the appointment of Lhoist S.A.'s CEO, Philipp Niemann, to Martin Marietta's Board of Directors. A staggered lock-up period applies to the consideration shares, and a standstill agreement caps LNA Holding's ownership at 18%.

articles.headline: Martin Marietta Finalizes $13.5 Billion Acquisition of Lhoist North America

events.title: Kimco Realty stock holds after August 4 earnings beat

The retail REIT also raised its annual dividend to $1.12, yielding 4.7%, and reaffirmed its FY 2026 guidance, aligning with Street estimates. The company's focus on grocery-anchored, open-air shopping centers and a robust market capitalization support its current valuation and future growth potential.

articles.headline: Kimco Realty stock holds after August 4 earnings beat

events.title: Valero Energy stock advances as Jefferies lifts target and Q2 2026 refining profits surge
events.summary: Valero Energy stock is trading near record highs after Jefferies significantly increased its price target to $401 from $312, citing strong second-quarter 2026 refining profits driven by favorable crack spreads. The company reported $4.5 billion in refining operating income and holds $7.87 billion in cash, demonstrating robust profitability despite ongoing maintenance at its Norco refinery. While the stock has seen substantial year-to-date gains, the new target suggests further upside, positioning Valero favorably within the energy sector.

articles.headline: Valero Energy stock advances as Jefferies lifts target and Q2 2026 refining profits surge

events.title: McCormick stock holds bullish tone as merger and earnings reshape the flavor leader
events.summary: McCormick & Company (MKC) stock is displaying a bullish trend, driven by strong second-quarter 2026 earnings that beat expectations and reaffirmed full-year guidance. This positive performance is further bolstered by a planned $65 billion merger with a substantial portion of Unilever’s food business, which is set to significantly expand McCormick's scale in the global spice, condiments, and prepared-foods market. Technical analysis points to a support level of $53.70 and a resistance target of $60.00, reinforcing the near-term bullish outlook for investors.

articles.headline: McCormick stock holds bullish tone as merger and earnings reshape the flavor leader

events.title: US and Canada fall deeper into a trade war with new tariffs as talks collapse and blame is spread
events.summary: The United States and Canada have fallen deeper into a trade war after negotiations collapsed, leading to new tariffs from both sides. The US imposed 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods, with Canada retaliating with its own penalties set to begin on September 8th. Both nations are blaming each other for the failed talks, raising concerns about the future of their historically cooperative relationship and potential impacts on their economies.

articles.headline: US and Canada fall deeper into a trade war with new tariffs as talks collapse and blame is spread
